verdict.rationale: SumUp's own docs show in-person, card-present acceptance via physical card readers (Solo, Go) and contactless Tap to Pay on a compatible phone, so the core of the story is delivered. The evidence never explicitly mentions chip/EMV insertion. It also never documents Apple Pay or Google Pay acceptance in person: the only Apple Pay item is an online checkout merchant-session endpoint, which does not transfer to card-present. Missing for 10: explicit chip/EMV support documentation, explicit in-person Apple Pay/Google Pay wallet acceptance, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can accept chip, contactless, and mobile-wallet (Apple Pay / Google Pay) payments in person

citations.quote: SumUp's in-person payment products let you accept card payments face-to-face using physical card readers or Tap to Pay on a mobile device.
Tap to Pay lets merchants accept in-person contactless payments directly on a compatible phone without carrying a separate card reader.
Trigger and manage payments on Solo or Go readers via HTTPS requests.
